
set(BENCHMARKS_SOURCE_DIR src)

set(BENCHMARKS_SOURCE_CODES
    ${BENCHMARKS_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp)

add_executable(${BENCHMARK_TARGET_NAME} ${BENCHMARKS_SOURCE_CODES})
target_compile_definitions(${TESTS_TARGET_NAME}
    PRIVATE LIBRARY_NAMESPACE_PREFIX=${LIBRARY_NAMESPACE_PREFIX})
# if (STANDALONE_BUILD)
#    add_dependencies(${BENCHMARK_TARGET_NAME} ReceiverModule)
# endif()
# target_include_directories(${BENCHMARK_TARGET_NAME} 
#    PUBLIC ${RECEIVERMODULE_INCLUDE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(${BENCHMARK_TARGET_NAME}
    PRIVATE ${PROJECT_NAME}
    PRIVATE ${BENCHMARK_COMPONENTS}
    PRIVATE ${Microsoft.GSL_COMPONENTS}
    PRIVATE ${GLOG_COMPONENTS})

set_target_properties(
    ${BENCHMARK_TARGET_NAME}
    PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/Debug
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/Release)

install(TARGETS ${BENCHMARK_TARGET_NAME}
    CONFIGURATIONS Debug Release
    RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
